title: LLMOrchestratorOutput
description: Structured output from LLM orchestrator: intent, order_id, clarification or proceed.

order_id.description: Resolved order ID (ORD-XXXX) if mentioned or from context.

clarification_message.description: Message to user when proceed is false (e.g. ask for order ID).

proceed.description: True to route to agent; false to return clarification_message.
